title: A merge trial reruns a failing test file once and files it as flaky when the rerun passes
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: a candidate whose merge trial fails a test once and passes its rerun of the same tree merges, and master status lists the 'Flaky check on main' item filed for that test.

steps.name: Merge a candidate whose trial fails a test once through the real loop and read master status
